headline: Karissa had a night-time fall at home on 2026-09-23, then an ED visit for dehydration and dizziness on 2026-11-05. PT found unsteady gait and a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds.

items.statement: On 2026-09-23 Karissa fell in the bathroom at night, and her son Marcus found her on the floor. She denied head strike or loss of consciousness, and no injury was noted. Fall risk was reassessed as high and a PT referral was placed.
items.verifier_note: All details (date, bathroom at night, son Marcus found her, denied head strike/LOC, no injury, fall risk high, PT referral) appear in the nursing note.

items.statement: On 2026-11-05 Karissa was seen in the partner hospital ED for dehydration and dizziness. She was treated and released the same day with no new medications. At the 2026-11-11 PCP follow-up she was back to baseline per her son, discharge medications were reviewed, and the plan was close monitoring for two weeks.
items.verifier_note: The ED summary, the PCP follow-up note and the encounter record support the 2026-11-05 ED visit, same-day release, no new medications, the 2026-11-11 follow-up, back to baseline per son, discharge medications reviewed, and close monitoring for two weeks.

items.statement: The PT evaluation on 2026-10-01 found slow, unsteady gait with intermittent cane use and a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds. PT recommended a front-wheeled walker, a home safety evaluation, and bathroom grab bars. PT will see her twice weekly for strength and balance.
items.verifier_note: The PT evaluation note matches every detail: gait findings, TUG 19 s, walker, home safety evaluation, grab bars, and twice-weekly sessions.
